statement: theorem trajectory_finite_loss (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (t : ℕ) (hloss : BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : loss t (output V η loss x₁ p t) = ((loss t (output V η loss x₁ p t)).toReal : EReal) ∧ loss t u = ((loss t u).toReal : EReal)
